Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Binod Kumar , Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 19-08-2023 1. Despite valid service of report nobody appears on behalf of O. P No. 2.
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

3. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A,
494, 323 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
4. As per the prosecution case, petitioner along with other family members committed torture on the informant's daughter due to non-fulfilment of dowry demand.

5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner while Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69404 of 2022(4) dt.19-08-2023 denying the allegations, submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case because he is husband of the victim.
However, he is ready to keep the victim to her matrimonial house with honour and dignity.
The case is triable by the Magistrate.
The petitioner has further relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182.
